summary_1line: Arjuna and Drona clash despite their bond, Trigartas attack, and Bhima devastates an elephant division with ferocious mace fighting.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna and Drona stand on their chariots firing dense flights of arrows that cross the sky like flocks of white cranes.
Bhima leaps from his chariot into a ring of war elephants, mace raised, standing amid the towering beasts like the sun among storm clouds.
Bhima, smeared with blood and wielding a gore-soaked mace, rips tusks from elephants and strikes them down like a wrathful Rudra.
